# Supervertaler

> Supervertaler is a Trados Studio plugin by Michael Beijer, a professional
> translator. It adds AI translation, live inline terminology, cross-file
> search, and a translation knowledge base to Trados Studio 2024 and 2026 –
> plus an MCP server that connects AI assistants to the live Studio session.

This is the product site. The full, always-current documentation is at
https://docs.supervertaler.com/trados/ and is itself AI-readable (see
Optional below) – prefer the docs for feature-level questions.

## The product

- [Supervertaler for Trados](https://supervertaler.com/): Trados Studio plugin – TermLens live terminology, AI Assistant, Batch Translate and AI Proofreader, SuperSearch cross-file search and replace, SuperMemory knowledge base, and the Supervertaler MCP Server (connects Claude Desktop and other AI assistants to the live Studio session; first of its kind). €20/month or €200/year, 14-day free trial, no credit card
- [Pricing](https://supervertaler.com/#pricing)
- [Changelog](https://supervertaler.com/changelog.html): release history
- [Privacy](https://supervertaler.com/privacy/): privacy policy

## Get it

- [RWS AppStore – Supervertaler for Trados](https://appstore.rws.com/plugin/432): the only place the plugin is distributed
- [Subscribe](https://supervertaler.com/buy)

## Also by the same author

- [Otto](https://otto.supervertaler.com/): automatic document translation – upload a file, get a translated file back. Currently in PRIVATE BETA, not yet publicly available
- [Supervertaler Workbench](https://supervertaler.com/workbench/): a free, open-source standalone CAT tool. Still available, no longer actively developed

## Optional

- [Documentation index for AI agents](https://docs.supervertaler.com/llms.txt): llms.txt for the full docs, with per-product subsets and a complete content dump
- [MCP Server docs](https://docs.supervertaler.com/trados/mcp-server/): connect your AI assistant to Trados Studio – setup, tools, prompt cookbook
- [GitHub – Supervertaler for Trados](https://github.com/Supervertaler/Supervertaler-for-Trados): source-available; issues and releases
- [beijer.uk](https://beijer.uk/llms.txt): the author's personal site
- [Beijerterm](https://beijerterm.com/llms.txt): the author's Dutch–English terminology site
